messages:
sam: Pager fired for increased 5xx rate on gen-queue in us-west. I'm oncall and have started a quick triage. Checking recent deploys and queue backlog.
oncall-bot: ALERT: gen-queue error-rate > 5% for 3m (us-west). Pager sent to sam, lee. Incident ID: INC-2026-245.
lee: looking at task runners now — seeing a spike in gkernel OOMs on workers. Correlating with a spike in long-tail requests.
sam: thanks. can you confirm if this is a model-specific regression or infra?
lee: preliminary: infra (kernel OOM) causing workers to recycle, which then requeues requests and increases contention. Not seeing model errors in logs.
sam: ok — ops playbook step 1/2: scale transient workers + throttle long-running jobs. I'm going to add capacity and flip routing to degraded pool.
lee: adding +10 workers in us-west-az1 now. patching autoscaler policy to be more aggressive.
kate: heads-up for comms: we'll need an initial status update for customers. Draft below — please review and shorten if needed.
kate: ```Initial update (publishing to status.redwood.com):
We are investigating elevated error rates affecting generation requests in the US-West region. Some requests are returning 5xx errors or timing out. Our on-call team is actively mitigating the issue by adding capacity and routing traffic to healthy pools. We will post periodic updates. If you are experiencing issues, please retry requests or route to another region.```
sam: good start. change "route to another region" -> "consider retrying or using a different region if latency constraints allow" (avoid suggesting all customers can switch).
ops_lead: add estimated customer impact line: "Customers in US-West may see increased latencies and intermittent errors for generation endpoints. Other regions unaffected." Also add an ETA for next update in 15 minutes.
kate: updated draft: ```Update 1: We are aware of elevated error rates and intermittent 5xx responses for generation endpoints in the US‑West region. On-call engineers have added capacity and enabled degraded routing for affected requests. Impact: increased latencies and intermittent errors for some customers in US‑West. Other regions are not affected. Next update: in ~15 minutes.```
legal: wording check: avoid "customers" implying universal impact. Suggest: "some customers" is fine. Also remove any SLA language.
sam: ack. final tweak applied. statusbot: please schedule initial publish and mark update-window.
statusbot: Draft published to internal staging (not public). URL: https://staging-status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-2026-245. Use /publish when ready.
lee: mitigations showing improvement — 5xx down from 6.2% -> 1.1% after capacity add. Latency tail still elevated but trending down.
kate: good — time to push the initial public update. Sam, please confirm when you want me to hit publish.
sam: publish now.
statusbot: Publishing public update...
statusbot: Public update posted: https://status.redwood.com/INC-2026-245 — Initial update published.
ops_lead: scheduled next check in 15m. If metrics continue improving, prepare resolved copy.
lee: continued improvement; tracking a soak for 20 minutes before resolve.
kate: draft resolved notice ready: ```Resolved: The elevated error rates for generation endpoints in US‑West have been resolved. Root cause: kernel OOMs on a subset of worker hosts causing restarts and request requeues. Mitigation: added capacity, adjusted autoscaler, and removed problematic hosts from rotation. We are monitoring for recurrence. If you continue to see issues, contact support.```
sam: minor edit: remove "removed problematic hosts" -> "isolated affected hosts" (more precise). Also add links to post-incident follow-up note.
kate: updated resolved draft and queued for publish after soak.
lee: metrics stable for 22 minutes, 5xx < 0.5% and tail latency near baseline.
sam: publish resolved.
statusbot: Resolved update published to public page: https://status.redwood.com/INC-2026-245 — Resolved. Incident channel will remain open for postmortem notes.
legal: please don't include specific host identifiers in public copy; internal postmortem can have the IPs and logs.
ops_lead: noted. postmortem owners: lee (tech lead), sam (oncall), kate (comms). Target doc in /confluence/incidents/INC-2026-245-PM by EOD tomorrow.
kate: thanks everyone. closing public comms flow. :thumbsup:
sam: wrapping up oncall handoff to next shift — I'll include context and links to the status page in the pager.
statusbot: On-call handoff recorded. New oncall: dana.
lee: quick note for postmortem: include autoscaler tuning thresholds and a suggestion to add early OOM detection alerts.
ops_lead: agree. Adding to follow-up checklist.
kate: will prepare customer-facing post-incident summary once we have RCA.
sam: great work team.
